definitions.clock: ns per page: native render call; Node page.render call through render promise
definitions.excluded: open, page lookup, viewport, Node canvas allocation, IPC, RGBA hashing/readback and cleanup
definitions.state: one open document per case per arm; all rounds reported including first pass
definitions.summary: per case/arm across all page-round samples; median, nearest-rank p95, max; pages / summed render seconds
definitions.rss: process scope, sampled after hashing; native A/A0 share supervisor, P is persistent Node; non-Windows native helper may return peak
definitions.pre_cpu: system busy percent sampled for 0.2s before each complete round; never filtered
definitions.pixels: SHA256 active RGBA; null identity enforced; cross-engine hashes are descriptive only
definitions.lock: operator owns bench-lock externally; tool does not acquire or release it
